note: Tenant and campaign ids are 16-byte opaque identifiers assigned by the Aether control plane. They are bound cryptographically into every reward proof (see audit/replay-isolation-proof.md). tenant_id/campaign_id are recorded here as 32-char lowercase hex (16 bytes). A proof is only valid for the exact (chain, program, tenant, campaign, mint, recipient, amount) tuple it was signed for.

binding_rules.proof_scope: chain_id + program_id + tenant_id + campaign_id + mint + recipient + amount + action + nonce + expiry
binding_rules.isolation_guarantee: Changing ANY scope field changes the signed message bytes, so an Ed25519 proof cannot be replayed across chains, programs, tenants, campaigns, recipients, assets, or amounts.
binding_rules.nonce_scope: Replay records are keyed by SHA-256(NONCE_TAG | program | chain | tenant | campaign | mint | nonce); the same raw nonce in two domains yields two distinct records.
